name: Mouse Odometer
author: irhop
description: A live graph of how far your mouse has actually travelled — today, this week, all time.

barWidget.description: Sparkline and distance for the mouse movement your hand actually made, measured from raw evdev counts

schema.label: Graph
schema.description: hours (the last hours), days (the last days) or off

schema.label: Graph columns
schema.description: How many hours or days the sparkline covers

schema.label: Show trend arrow
schema.description: Today against the last seven days, as ↓12% / ↑8%

schema.label: Show the number
schema.description: Turn off for a graph-only widget

schema.label: Daily goal (metres)
schema.description: The widget turns urgent past this. 0 turns the goal off.

schema.label: Install the tracker automatically
schema.description: On first load, install and start the omarchy-mouse-odometer user service. Turn off to start it yourself.
